character.name: Idle
character.prompt:
A Korean man in his mid-thirties who owns a small general store in a 1990s rural village. He has neatly side-parted short black hair, alert eyes, and a polished friendly shopkeeper smile with a slightly calculating expression. He looks tidy, confident, and attentive to customers.

He wears a faded light-blue collared shirt with rolled sleeves, a muted rust-brown shop apron, dark charcoal trousers, and clean brown shoes. Average adult proportions with a slightly large head, tidy posture, and a clear readable silhouette.

Cozy Korean countryside mystery game character, muted natural colors, simple low-detail pixel art, restrained two-step shading, subtle dark-brown selective outlines, low top-down camera view.

No hat, no glasses, no weapon, no item in hands, no modern accessories, no text, plain transparent background.
